## Overview & Core Philosophy
Anton Mykhailov specializes in systems programming, device & chip orchestration, and high-efficiency architectures:
- Minimal resource overhead (0 KB VRAM / Headless architectures)
- High battery life and performance for mobile & embedded devices
- 100% on-device data processing (no tracking, zero third-party telemetry, no analytics SDKs)
- Native, mobile, graphical, and embedded platforms: Android (Kotlin/Java), robotics & industrial control (ROS 2, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, PLC), VM/bytecode engines, TUI environments, and competitive game AI.

## Published & Featured Projects

### 1. Tdroid (TUI Desktop & Launcher for Android)
- **Platforms**: Android (Free & Pro editions on Google Play)
- **Description**: Ultra-lightweight terminal/TUI desktop environment for Android smartphones and tablets. Replaces heavy graphical launchers with an efficient, keyboard-first text console interface.
- **Key Features**:
  - Pure terminal interface with instantaneous launch time and minimal battery consumption (9–15 MB RAM footprint).
  - Built-in multitasking, app management, file navigation, and system diagnostics.
  - Zero telemetry and full offline capability.

### 2. TDscript Core 1.1 / TDModules v1.4.0 — Universal Device, Chip & Robotics Platform
- **Platforms / Scope**: Cross-platform (Linux, Windows, Android, Embedded, Robotics, GUI & TUI Applications)
- **Release Status**: Stable Release v1.4.0 (Core 1.1 Specification compliant)
- **Description**:
  TDscript (TextDroid Script) — компактная межплатформенная программная экосистема и детерминированный язык сценарного управления для робототехники, промышленной автоматизации, микросхем и физических шин (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Modbus TCP/RTU) с нулевым оверхедом видеопамяти (0 KB VRAM / Headless).
- **Key Technical Innovations (Core 1.1)**:
  - **Granular CapabilityScope Sandboxing**: Hardware-level whitelisting. Restricts scripts by physical address boundaries: authorized I2C addresses (e.g. Bosch BME280 @ 0x76), Modbus register ranges (100..200), and specific serial ports.
  - **Native 109-Language Multilingualism**: Lexer-level `language: <code>;` directive. State-machine `CodeProjector` toggles keywords between languages (RU 🇷🇺, EN 🇬🇧, DE 🇩🇪) on the fly without touching string literals or comments. Safe `LString` symbolic resources prohibit direct concatenation (`TDS_E105`) to maintain grammar integrity across 109 languages.
  - **Fail-Safe Watchdog & Step Limit**: Hardware watchdog (`WATCHDOG.feed()`, `WATCHDOG.emergencyStop()`) and runtime execution step limiter (`maxSteps = 10_000_000L` -> `TDS_E106_STEP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`) preventing runaway loops in physical machinery.
  - **Expanded Capabilities Matrix (16 flags)**: `NET_READ` (0x0001), `NET_SCAN` (0x0002), `PLC_READ` (0x0004), `PLC_WRITE` (0x0008), `BT_ACCESS` (0x0010), `HARDWARE` (0x0020), `UI_CORE` (0x0040), `BACKGROUND` (0x0080), `I2C_READ` (0x0100), `I2C_WRITE` (0x0200), `SPI_TRANSFER` (0x0400), `SERIAL_RAW` (0x0800), `CAN_BUS` (0x1000), `ROBOT_MOTION` (0x2000), `ROBOT_OVERRIDE` (0x4000), `DRIVER_INSTALL` (0x8000).
  - **Deterministic Bytecode (.tbc)**: Binary opcode compilation (2–10 KB) with Ed25519 digital signatures and SHA-256 integrity checks.

### 3. TDscript Studio IDE & Autonomous AI Agentic Loop
- **Platforms**: Desktop (Linux / Windows) & Android (Mobile App)
- **Description**: Cross-platform development and simulation environment for TDscript Core 1.1 with an integrated autonomous AI Agent.
- **Key Architecture & Features**:
  - **Autonomous Agentic Loop**: Closed-loop agent workflow: *Hardware Discovery (`probe()`) ➔ Prompt Construction with JSON environment ➔ Code Generation ➔ Execution in `AiHardwareSandbox` ➔ Machine-readable error capture (`CompilerErrorDiagnostic.toJson()`) ➔ Automated code fix (up to 3–5 iterations)*.
  - **Zero-Dependency LlmClient**: Native OpenAI-compatible HTTP client for local engines (Ollama: `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`, LM Studio: `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`) and cloud APIs.
  - **AiHardwareSandbox**: Virtual testbench emulating Bosch BME280 environmental IC (0x76, Chip ID 0x60 in register 0xD0) and Modbus PLC Gateway (127.0.0.1:502, registers 100 & 101).
  - **Desktop Edition**: Compose Desktop GUI with split-view code editor, real-time register inspector, and standalone executable Linux JAR (`tdscript-studio-linux-x64-1.1.0.jar`).
  - **Android Edition**: Mobile application (5.5 MB APK) with `AndroidHostSPI` supporting USB-OTG devices (`UsbManager`), Bluetooth LE GATT, and virtual sandbox.

### 4. TDRobotics (Android Robotics Engineering Environment)
- **Platforms**: Android (Standalone Engineering Tool)
- **Description**: Mobile CAD and programming suite for building, simulating, and validating physical circuits and robots.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Circuit Canvas & Dynamic DIP Generator**: Parametric physical IC package generator for DIP-8, DIP-14, DIP-16, DIP-20, DIP-28, DIP-40.
  - **Deterministic Circuit Analyzer**: Strict on-device physical safety audit (overvoltage protection 5V -> 3.3V, common ground verification, UART cross-wiring check).
  - **Multi-Target Project Exporter**: Single-click compilation into signed Android APK (`.apk`), Windows executable (`.exe`), Linux AppImage (`.AppImage`), or desktop JAR (`.jar`).

### 5. Sevens & Nines («Сімки та Дев'ятки» / «Семёрки и Девятки»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Google Play) & Linux/Desktop
- **Description**: Cross-platform card game simulator featuring classic regional and international rules:
  - Eastern European / Ukrainian "Nine" (36-card deck)
  - International "Sevens" (Parliament / Fan Tan, 52-card deck)
  - Card Dominoes / Fan Tan with chips and pass penalties
- **Key Features**:
  - Heuristic AI bots with opponent hand analysis and tactical blocking.
  - Custom decks and table felts (Emerald, Sapphire, Bordeaux, Graphite).
  - Procedural lightweight audio.

### 6. TCM Canons («Каноны ТКМ: Древняя Мудрость»)
- **Platforms**: Android (Capacitor/Vite), Web
- **Description**: Interactive educational encyclopedia and study platform for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) ancient treatises. Includes acupoints atlas, 5 elements (Wu Xing), pharmacology, and 100-question certification exam generating authentic PDF diplomas.
